rationale: Abstract uses positive prompt injection as an engineering technique for unit-test generation/repair, not malicious-versus-benign prompt-injection input detection.
Abstract evaluates multimodal robotic navigation under prompt-injection attacks and secure prompting; no separate binary text input-classifier evaluation is identified.
Abstract studies personal-information extraction and uses prompt injection as a countermeasure against extractors, outside the approved input-detection task.

Abstract establishes malicious-versus-legitimate prompt classification using BERT prompt embeddings. It does not establish whether evaluation includes qualifying English text; multilingual encoder capability alone does not establish the evaluation language.
